items.text: New status text: “In force since 10 November 2026. The revised ESRS apply from financial year 2027; the voluntary standard has been in force since 24 September 2026.”
items.reason: Updates the status text as the entry into force date of 10 November 2026 has now passed.

items.text: Add the date 2026-11-12: “EU ETS provisional agreement reached on boosting free carbon allowances”
items.reason: Council and Parliament reached a provisional agreement on 12 November 2026 to boost free carbon allowances for energy-intensive industries.

items.text: Change the stage from Adopted to In force
items.reason: The revised ESRS entered into force on 10 November 2026.

items.text: Add the date 2026-11-19: “SFDR 2.0 provisional agreement reached in trilogues”
items.reason: The European Parliament and the Council reached a provisional agreement on the SFDR 2.0 review on 19 November 2026.

items.text: New status text: “Provisional agreement reached between the Council and Parliament on 19 November 2026. The agreed text now awaits formal adoption by both co-legislators.”
items.reason: Trilogue negotiations concluded with a provisional agreement on 19 November 2026.

items.text: New status text: “Applies. SFDR 2.0 will replace it following a provisional agreement reached by co-legislators on 19 November 2026.”
items.reason: Co-legislators reached a provisional agreement on SFDR 2.0, updating the status of the current SFDR framework.

items.text: Add the date 2026-11-04: “Green Claims Commission officially withdraws the proposal”
items.reason: The European Commission officially confirmed the withdrawal of the Green Claims Directive proposal in November 2026.
